fem.text: Oliver Farrel and his followers formally break their ties with the rest of Icatia after the fall of Trokair and become a formidable band of vigilantes battling Icatians and followers of Tourach.

Farrel whips Montford into a frenzy against the Ebon Hand and appoints Sianna as his champion to slay Tymolin, and the Farrelites ambush Tev and Tymolin, though Tev disenchants Farrel's mantle and the siblings are separated.
Vaylesh captures Tymolin and lures the Farrelites to the Ebon Hand camp, where Farrel stabs Tymolin to death when she refuses him.
Sensing her death, Tev transforms into the dragon-like Tevesh Szat and incinerates Vaylesh, Farrel and Sianna and their forces.
